Lonesome Luke, Circus King is a 1916 American short comedy film featuring Harold Lloyd. It is considered a lost film.
Cast
* Harold Lloyd as Lonesome Luke
* Snub Pollard
* Bebe Daniels
* Gene Marsh
Reception
In a April 15, 1916 review, Moving Picture World wrote that the film was "an entertaining number for those who like slapstick comedy."
